  • Constructor Details

    • RankingPolicy

      public RankingPolicy(String id, String name, String provenance, String metricId, String metricName, ProcessModelDebottleneckStudy.MetricKind metricKind, String unit, String basis, String metricProvenance, String effectivePeriod, ProcessModelDebottleneckRanking.RankingDirection direction, double tieTolerance, double baselineRelativeTolerance, double minimumAlternativeConfidence, double minimumMetricConfidence)
      Creates a fully qualified single-metric ranking policy.
      Parameters:
      id - stable policy identifier
      name - human-readable policy name
      provenance - source and assumptions for the ranking policy
      metricId - exact registered metric identifier
      metricName - exact registered metric name
      metricKind - engineering role of the metric
      unit - exact engineering unit of the metric and its deltas
      basis - exact physical or commercial metric basis
      metricProvenance - exact metric source or factor provenance
      effectivePeriod - exact metric effective period
      direction - direction in which the paired delta improves
      tieTolerance - non-negative tie tolerance in the metric unit
      baselineRelativeTolerance - dimensionless relative tolerance in [0, 1] for repeated simulator values in an otherwise identical baseline
      minimumAlternativeConfidence - confidence floor in [0, 1], or NaN when unset
      minimumMetricConfidence - confidence floor in [0, 1], or NaN when unset
